note: The sound graph (doc 17, with doc 24's music bus). buses: the level of each bus at full on its Settings slider (the player's sliders scale these; src/audio/index.js); musicDefault is the music's. compressor: the gentle master limiter (dB, ratio, seconds). fades: seconds for the master fade in after the first touch, the fade out when the tab hides, and the fade in when it returns. island reverb: the shared outdoor air for ambience and creatures, about 1.2 s, made from filtered noise (no file); decayS is the time to fall 60 dB, hfDecayS how fast the highs fall (shorter is darker), sends per bus, preDelayMs. music reverb: the music's own room (doc 24), about 2.6 s and darker, with early reflections at the listed milliseconds (gain each, alternating left and right), and a wet level; it is never shared with the island. musicTone: the music bus's starting brightness (lowpass Hz); the floor, a 12 dB per octave high-pass at hz (q 0.707, no bump) under the lowest note, since every note stays at B1 (62 Hz) or above (voicing.json) and doc 24 keeps the music above 60 Hz: at 40 Hz it takes out pedal thumps and room rumble below the notes and leaves B1 about 1 dB down, where a 60 Hz cut would thin the bass by 3 dB; and the chorus EQ (a gentle dip near frog calls, doc 24) at hz with q and its dB when frogs are near (0 when not). duck: how far the music dips near a calling creature (dB) and the attack and release seconds. seed: the fixed seed for the reverb noise, so the room sounds the same every time. Music room 0.30 is Matt's headphone reference from the bench (October 19, 2026). The music level was 0.5 with the piano alone; heard against the island in the game (October 20, 2026) it sat about 5 dB under the island's sounds and Matt found it too quiet, so it is 1.0 (the island bus measured -32.6 dB, the music -31 dB before this level, during the summer home tide). The island sounds (ambience) are 0.84, 1.5 dB under full, since October 21, 2026: Matt found them a little loud; on October 24, 2026 they came down 2 dB more (0.67, about 3.5 dB under full), and the master came down 2 dB (0.79), since Matt kept his volume at half while playing.
